description: AWS CloudFormation template security check — Static security review of an AWS CloudFormation template (template= JSON or YAML, or url=). Flags public S3 buckets/policies, Principal * policies, admin wildcards, iam:PassRole on *, open security groups (SSH/RDP/DB ports), public or unencrypted RDS, hard-coded passwords and AWS keys, missing NoEcho, IMDSv1, deprecated Lambda runtimes, public Lambda invoke/URLs, CloudTrail off, KMS rotation, weak ALB/CloudFront TLS, OpenSearch encryption, public EKS API and ECR scanning. Returns findings with fixes, score, A-F grade and PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/FAIL. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cloudformation_check
